definitions.update: Actual FP32 master-weight difference across one optimizer step.
definitions.delta_fp32: FP32 master-weight difference from original initialization.
definitions.delta_bf16: Difference of BF16 model weights, including rounding-induced zeros.
definitions.energy_at_0.01: Fraction of squared L2 norm in the largest-magnitude 1% of coordinates.
definitions.energy90_fraction: Smallest fraction of coordinates carrying 90% of squared L2 norm.
definitions.sparsity_at_threshold: Fraction of absolute coordinate changes at most the threshold.

limitations: One training seed; sparse milestone measurements cannot establish statistical equivalence or exclude transient anomalies.
Single-teacher PG has measurements through step 100; compare single-teacher losses at step 100 and joint losses at step 250.
Probability mass uses each run's changing on-policy prefixes and its configured reduction: response means for DR, token means within logged training slices for DT/GT.
Distribution drift and parameter displacement are different quantities; these measurements do not establish a causal mechanism.
